name: Properties for PROV was generated by
abstract: Schema defining properties for documenting hardware or software used in the creation of a dataset. Defines properties: @type, prov:used.

sources.title: See Provenance for discovery in Implementation of metadata content items

description:
## PROV generated by (CDIF core)

The CDIF core definition of a `prov:wasGeneratedBy` value: a `prov:Activity` whose `prov:used` items are strings (an IRI or a free-text name) or objects that identify the entity by `@id`. `prov:used` is optional. The `@id` reference is open, so an extending profile may describe the entity in place as long as it keeps the `@id`.

This block is deliberately minimal. Profiles extend it and only narrow it: `cdifProvActivity` (the schema.org implementation, which records what an activity used with `schema:instrument` and `schema:object`) and `provActivity` (the PROV-O implementation). Uses terms from the base prov vocabulary. For the schema.org implementation of the [Cross Domain Interoperability Framework](https://cross-domain-interoperability-framework.github.io/cdifbook/metadata/schemaorgimplementation.html#implementation-of-metadata-content-items) (CDIF) core profile.

examples.title: Example PROV was generated by.
examples.content: very simple implementation for discovery-level representation of instruments or software used to generate a resource.

annotatedSchema:
$schema: https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema
title: Activity that generated the resource (CDIF core)
description: 'The CDIF core definition of a prov:wasGeneratedBy value: a prov:Activity
  whose prov:used items are strings or @id references. Any further structure belongs
  to the profiles that extend it (cdifProvActivity for the schema.org implementation,
  provActivity for the PROV-O one), which may only narrow it.'
type: object
required:
- '@type'
properties:
  '@type':
    type: array
    items:
      type: string
    minItems: 1
    contains:
      const: prov:Activity
    description: Must include prov:Activity. Stated as "contains" rather than a single
      value so an extending profile can add types (cdifProvActivity adds schema:Action).
  prov:used:
    type: array
    description: 'Entities the activity used. Optional. Each item is a string (an
      IRI or a free-text name) or an object that identifies the entity by @id. The
      @id reference is deliberately NOT sealed: an extending profile may describe
      the entity in place as long as it keeps the @id, and a profile that wants only
      bare references can seal it itself. Role-keyed wrappers (an object whose key
      names a role, with no @id) are not accepted; in the schema.org implementation
      what an activity used is recorded with schema:instrument and schema:object instead.'
    items:
      anyOf:
      - type: string
        description: an IRI or a free-text name of the entity used
      - type: object
        description: an entity used, identified by @id; it may also be described in
          place
        required:
        - '@id'
        properties:
          '@id':
            type: string
    x-jsonld-id: http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#used
x-jsonld-prefixes:
  schema: http://schema.org/
  prov: http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#
x-bblocks-metadata:
  itemIdentifier: cdif.bbr.metadata.provProperties.generatedBy
  register: https://cross-domain-interoperability-framework.github.io/metadataBuildingBlocks/build/register.json
  version: '0.1'
  dateOfLastChange: '2026-11-14'
